# Tools - [`jdeps`](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/25/docs/specs/man/jdeps.html)

The `jdeps` tool can be used to analyse the dependencies of a Java module.

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

## Run the example

1. Build the application

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean package
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the JAR file was created and copied to the
   `./target/libs` directory.

   ```shell
   tree --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR file

   ```
   ./target/libs
   ├── logback-classic-1.6.3.jar
   ├── logback-core-1.6.3.jar
   ├── slf4j-api-2.0.18.jar
   └── tools-jdeps.jar

   1 directory, 4 files
   ```

2. List all modules

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/libs' --list-modules
   ```

3. Describe the JAR file

   Describe the `tools-jdeps.jar`

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/tools-jdeps.jar'
   ```

   The application module description

   ```
   demo@1.0.0 jar:file:///./target/libs/tools-jdeps.jar!/module-info.class
   requires java.base mandated
   requires org.slf4j
   contains demo
   main-class demo.Main
   ```

4. Inspect application

   Note that `slf4j-api-2.0.18.jar` is a multi-release jar file, thus the Java
   version needs to be specified, using the `--multi-release` command line
   option.

   ```shell
   jdeps --module-path './target/libs' --multi-release 21 --module demo
   ```

   The dependencies for the application

   ```
   demo
    [file:///./target/libs/tools-jdeps.jar]
      requires mandated java.base (@25)
      requires org.slf4j (@2.0.18)
   demo -> java.base
   demo -> org.slf4j
      demo                                               -> java.lang                                          java.base
      demo                                               -> org.slf4j                                          org.slf4j
   ```

   The `demo` package in the `demo` module is using the `java.lang` package from
   within the `java.base` module and the `org.slf4j` from the `org.slf4j` module
   as indicated by the last two lines of the output.

   Inspect application classes

   ```shell
   jdeps \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --multi-release 21 \
     -verbose:class \
     --module demo
   ```

   This prints the details at class level.

   ```
   demo
    [file:///./target/libs/tools-jdeps.jar]
      requires mandated java.base (@25)
      requires org.slf4j (@2.0.18)
   demo -> java.base
   demo -> org.slf4j
      demo.Main                                          -> java.lang.Class                                    java.base
      demo.Main                                          -> java.lang.Object                                   java.base
      demo.Main                                          -> java.lang.String                                   java.base
      demo.Main                                          -> java.lang.System                                   java.base
      demo.Main                                          -> org.slf4j.Logger                                   org.slf4j
      demo.Main                                          -> org.slf4j.LoggerFactory                            org.slf4j
   ```

   Inspect application dependencies recursively

   ```shell
   jdeps \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --multi-release 21 \
     --recursive \
     --module demo
   ```

   This time we see two JAR files, the `app.jar` and the `slf4j-api-2.0.18.jar`.
   The logback JAR files, `logback-classic-1.6.3.jar` and
   `logback-core-1.6.3.jar`, are not included as these are loaded as services.
   Thus, there is no direct link between our application (the starting point)
   and these libraries.

   ```
   demo
    [file:///./target/libs/tools-jdeps.jar]
      requires mandated java.base (@25)
      requires org.slf4j (@2.0.18)
   demo -> java.base
   demo -> org.slf4j
      demo                                               -> java.lang                                          java.base
      demo                                               -> org.slf4j                                          org.slf4j
   org.slf4j
    [file:///./target/libs/slf4j-api-2.0.18.jar]
      requires java.base
   org.slf4j -> java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.io                                            java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.lang                                          java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.lang.invoke                                   java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.lang.reflect                                  java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.net                                           java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.security                                      java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.util                                          java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> java.util.concurrent                               java.base
      org.slf4j                                          -> org.slf4j                                          org.slf4j
      org.slf4j                                          -> org.slf4j.event                                    org.slf4j
      org.slf4j                                          -> org.slf4j.helpers                                  org.slf4j
      org.slf4j                                          -> org.slf4j.spi                                      org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.event                                    -> java.lang                                          java.base
      org.slf4j.event                                    -> java.util                                          java.base
      org.slf4j.event                                    -> org.slf4j                                          org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.event                                    -> org.slf4j.event                                    org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.event                                    -> org.slf4j.helpers                                  org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.event                                    -> org.slf4j.spi                                      org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> java.io                                            java.base
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> java.lang                                          java.base
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> java.lang.annotation                               java.base
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> java.lang.reflect                                  java.base
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> java.util                                          java.base
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> java.util.concurrent                               java.base
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> org.slf4j                                          org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> org.slf4j.event                                    org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> org.slf4j.helpers                                  org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.helpers                                  -> org.slf4j.spi                                      org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.spi                                      -> java.lang                                          java.base
      org.slf4j.spi                                      -> java.util                                          java.base
      org.slf4j.spi                                      -> java.util.function                                 java.base
      org.slf4j.spi                                      -> org.slf4j                                          org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.spi                                      -> org.slf4j.event                                    org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.spi                                      -> org.slf4j.helpers                                  org.slf4j
      org.slf4j.spi                                      -> org.slf4j.spi                                      org.slf4j
   ```

5. Run the application

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --module demo
   ```

   The application will run and print the following

   ```
   12:34:56.789 [main] DEBUG demo.Main -- Tools - jdeps
   12:34:56.790 [main] DEBUG demo.Main -- Using Java 25.0.4.1
   ```
